flags.message: The October 6 as-stored snapshot carries an embedded source-creation date of September 24 and no proceeding after the September 21 opposition. Its sole distribution lists the September 28 conference but precedes a response request and extension. I did not infer actual consideration at that conference or survival of a subsequent order list, and did not retrieve current case status. This is a freshness limitation, not evidence of an already-decided cell.

The provisioned manifest marks the 136-page petition truncated. The substantive cert arguments, questions presented, and appellate memorandum at appendix 1a–8a are available; I did not assume the remaining appendix was complete. The opposition is usable and untruncated.
